title: Marking preserves nonemptiness
statement: Let $w$ be a natural number and let $\ell$ be a nonempty list of pairs in $\mathrm{Fin}\,w \times \{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. Then the marked list obtained from $\ell$ by appending a boolean flag to each entry — true on the final entry and false on every other — is again nonempty.
